description: B1 (the milestone A gate's row on the Woodway's thin margin): the quarry folk's warning post on the north road to Stoneback's quarry - shown once as the giant passes it, never after he is dead.
text: A warning post of the quarry folk: a cracked slab of his stone and an old giant's skull. Beyond it Stoneback hunts any giant he sees from his quarry - keep to the road, or go in ready to fight.
